title: C: Even or Odd
description: Check if a number is even or odd using the modulo operator and print the result.

steps.title: Check Even or Odd
steps.description: Declare `int num = 7`. Use if-else to check if it's even or odd. Print 'Even' or 'Odd'.
hints: The modulo operator `%` gives the remainder.
Use printf to print the result.
